course_notes: ROOT CAUSE: the OSM relation for Pevely Farms (5429230) borders Crescent Farms Golf Club (OSM way 365165194, an 18-hole course with OSM hole ways 884242539..884242556 refs 1-18). The Overpass fetch (bbox + 150 m) returned 23 hole ways: Pevely's 18 inside the boundary plus Crescent Farms' 1, 9, 10 and 18, whose ends reach into the bbox. The router picked the Crescent Farms ways for refs 1, 9, 10 and 18.

The fetch summary already shows it: golf_tag_counts hole 23 but golf_tag_counts_inside_course hole 18. The routing should prefer hole ways inside the course boundary when refs are duplicated (a platform fix; it affects any course next to another course).
Holes 1, 9, 10 and 18 on the page are not Pevely holes: black pictures (no imagery outside the bbox), no elevation, 0% fairway, aims at the +/-40 bound.

osm_supplement.geojson is not written: the geometry of Pevely's own ref-1/9/10/18 ways was not in the committed data. The OSM API request course_data/requests/webfetch_rv15_osmapi_pevely.json (rev 2, queued) will put it in course_data/research/web/rv15_osmapi_pevely/. Way 848080943 is Pevely's hole 1. Simplest rebuild: drop the hole ways outside the Pevely boundary (ids 884242539, 884242547, 884242548, 884242556), or add an 'ignore_osm_holes' + supplement of the 18 inside-boundary ways.
